conflict_flags.rationale: The SOW is the operative task-order document and 'Construct Door Opening' is the specific task identifier (PB00003-4J). The title sheet 'Renovate Facility' likely reflects the broader renovation program/drawing package that was reused for this task order. Both refer to the same physical work at Building 9023.
10-day difference between title sheet issue and D-101 as-built date. Minor; likely D-101 was finalized slightly after the title sheet. Both confirm construction was completed by mid-June 2025.
